definition.horizon_reason: Two subsequent guarded decisions: a short-horizon operational warning, allowing one decision/measurement cycle before a second-cycle violation. Fixed before development-score calculation, not selected from the target frequency.
definition.features: Entire observed allocation prefix from baseline through current epoch; current three normalized service headrooms and their last observed changes. Full shares and ILR receive the same initial allocations and all prefix endpoints.
definition.candidate_context: Same workload and epoch; nearest section per old runner pair; no query runner pair in development OOF; no confirmation observations in the library.
definition.geometry_scaling: One isotropic RMS scatter scale per representation/resource, fitted only to training snapshots. Zero-scatter blocks omitted. Preserve within-resource ILR metric and raw-share Euclidean metric, no per-coordinate standardization.
definition.business_scaling: Clip each current headroom and its previous-window change to [-1,1]; no fit or future observations. Same features for every allocation representation.
definition.budget_reason: One false warning decision per twenty non-event decision opportunities as a PoC operating point. Not a null probability, significance level or scientific pass/fail criterion. All development thresholds and independent achieved rates retained.
definition.threshold_selection: From OOF development scores choose threshold maximizing event-window recall subject to the empirical false-warning decision rate budget; ties prefer fewer false decisions, then higher threshold. Include the disabled rule. Freeze once before confirmation.
definition.target: Current valid safe window: any valid unsafe outcome in either next two cycles under the unchanged guarded policy. Unknown future horizons are not negative; an observed positive within the horizon remains known.
definition.primary_outcome: First-violation history preceded by a valid safe alert within horizon and before the first violating window begins. Report missed violations, false warning decisions, precision, achieved false-warning rate and timestamp-based lead intervals; no binary scientific criterion.
definition.runtime_mode: Observer only. Emit all four scores and frozen alert labels after primary measurements become available and before subsequent controller action. Never influence adaptation.
definition.scope: Independent validation under these constructed guarded conditions; no production prevalence, universal coordinate superiority or dynamic RAM drift claim.

scope: Frozen before new confirmation observations; development counts are not confirmation performance.
